text.ko: 업종 내 매우 약함. 약점: 영업이익률 3.1%.
text.en: Very weak within its sector. Weakness: Operating margin 3.1%.

text.en: Very weak within its sector. Weakness: 3-yr revenue growth (annual) -15.8%.

text.en: Weak within its sector. Strength: Price to book 1.83x. Weakness: Price to earnings n/m (negative).

text.ko: 현재 경제 환경의 영향은 중립적이에요. 주요 요인: 물가 상승 압력 국면 (유리). 부채가 많은 편이라 금리 영향이 더 커요.
text.en: The current economy is roughly neutral for this sector. Main factor: rising inflation (helps). Higher debt makes it more rate-sensitive.
